Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Enterprises across industries are exploring AI to rethink problem-solving and redefine business processes. Rama Akkiraju, vice president of IT for AI and machine learning at NVIDIA, joined the AI Podcast to discuss how enterprises can build the right foundations for AI success. What’s striking, Akkiraju pointed out, is the acceleration in the technology’s evolution: the shift from perception to generative AI took about 30 years, but the leap to agentic AI happened in just two. Akkiraju also spoke about the critical role of AI platform architects in designing and building AI infrastructure based on specific business needs. Enterprise implementations require complex stacks including data ingestion pipelines, vector databases, security controls and evaluation frameworks — and platform architects serve as the bridge between strategic business vision and technical execution.
